items.markdown:
Care home development finance is `a specialist commercial loan used to buy land, convert existing buildings, or build new healthcare facilities` . Lenders look at both construction costs and the future business value. Major UK providers like [Shawbrook Bank](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/business/business-lending/healthcare/care-home-finance/), [Paragon Development Finance](https://www.paragonbank.co.uk/press-releases/paragon-development-finance-launches-specialist-care-home-funding-product-supporting-experienced-operators-and-uk-care-provision) , and [OakNorth Bank](https://oaknorth.co.uk/business-loans/senior-living/) offer tailored funding packages for these projects.[](https://rangewell.com/care-homes/development-finance-for-care-homes) [[1]](https://rangewell.com/care-homes/development-finance-for-care-homes)[[2]](https://oaknorth.co.uk/business-loans/senior-living/)[[3]](https://www.commercialpropertydevelopmentfinance.co.uk/property-types/care-home-development-finance/)[[4]](https://www.paragonbank.co.uk/press-releases/paragon-development-finance-launches-specialist-care-home-funding-product-supporting-experienced-operators-and-uk-care-provision)[[5]](https://www.commercialtrust.co.uk/news/best-development-finance-lenders-2026/)Core Types of Funding

- **Land and build loans:** Upfront capital released in stages to cover construction milestones.
- **Conversion finance:** Loans to buy and transform commercial or residential buildings into compliant care settings.
- **Asset and equipment finance:** Secondary funding lines for specialized hoists, commercial kitchens, medical beds, and interior fittings.
- **Mezzanine finance:** Higher-risk top-up loans used alongside senior debt to bridge gaps in large schemes.[](https://rangewell.com/care-homes/development-finance-for-care-homes) [[1]](https://rangewell.com/care-homes/guides/how-to-get-funding-for-your-care-home)[[2]](https://adlergreen.co.uk/development-finance/ground-up-new-build-development-finance/)[[3]](https://www.christiefinance.com/commercial-mortgages/care-mortgages/)

Key Lender Requirements

- **Operator experience:** Proof of a strong track record in running care facilities or partnering with experienced operators.
- **Robust business plans:** Detailed cash flow forecasts, staffing models, and regulatory compliance strategies.
- **CQC awareness:** Understanding of Care Quality Commission registration standards and local market bed demand.
- **Exit or refinance strategy:** A clear path to transition the short-term development loan into a long-term commercial mortgage once occupancy stabilizes.[](https://www.paragonbank.co.uk/press-releases/paragon-development-finance-launches-specialist-care-home-funding-product-supporting-experienced-operators-and-uk-care-provision) [[1]](https://www.paragonbank.co.uk/press-releases/paragon-development-finance-launches-specialist-care-home-funding-product-supporting-experienced-operators-and-uk-care-provision)[[2]](https://www.assetzcapital.co.uk/navigating-care-home-financing-a-comprehensive-guide/)[[3]](https://brickflow.com/commercial-mortgage/care-home-mortgage)[[4]](https://www.corecocommercial.co.uk/care-home-finance/)

If you are planning a project, tell me:

- Are you **building from scratch** or **converting an existing property**?
- Do you have **prior care operating experience**?

I can help outline what financial information you need to prepare next.
